architecture: One Knowledge Graph · Two Learning Paths
purpose: Inventory the six evidence dimensions for all 16 semantically reconciled Grade-8 KNTT rows before any new authoring. Evidence is not inferred from taxonomy identity alone.

dimension_definitions.SKILL_MAP: Semantic curriculum-to-skill/family/local mapping; not learner evidence by itself.
dimension_definitions.LEARN_CONTENT: Explicit learner-facing explanation/content that directly teaches the row's semantic target.
dimension_definitions.MICRO_PRACTICE: Short formative practice explicitly aligned to the row.
dimension_definitions.PRACTICE_BANK: Reusable interactive practice evidence; shared-topic evidence must not be overstated as exact lesson evidence.
dimension_definitions.WRITTEN_LIBRARY: Canonical Written item with true Grade-8 KNTT placement, not prerequisite overlap.
dimension_definitions.READINESS: Structured independently interpreted readiness evidence; absence means NOT_VERIFIED, not learner deficiency.

summary.note: Inventory only. P1/P2 labels identify audit candidates, not authoring authorization. Bài 38-39 is not prioritized because Grade-8-specific pyramid skills already have direct Micro evidence; the missing shared foundation skills are not treated as a density quota.
